_doc: How people talk about YOU (NPCVoice.remark): open_<mood> + pc_<topic> + close_<voice>. Topics: pc_class_/pc_age_/pc_bg_/pc_pers_/pc_goal_/pc_secret_<tag id>, pc_<state>, npc_life. Vars: {name} {years} {credits} {debt} {bounty} {fame} {followers} {crew} {controller} {crisis} {antagonist} {ally} {macguffin} {scheme} {objective_planet} {other_planet} {local_name} {job} {need}.

open_warm: Good to see a face that isn't an ad.
close_poor: Spare a credit? No? Worth asking.
Don't tell my landlord I talked.
I've got a queue to stand in.
close_worker: They dock us for talking, you know.
close_artsy: I'm putting you in a song.
Art is dead. Long live art.
close_rebel: Remember: they need us more than we need them.
close_weird: I've said too much. Or not enough.
Tell the walls I said hello.
That's what the static told me.
close_merchant: That advice is free. Everything else isn't.
Special price for you. Same as everyone.
close_robot: THIS OPINION IS NOT ENDORSED BY MY MANUFACTURER.
pc_class_heir_paragon: Your family's cops arrested my cousin for coughing. Nothing personal.
A Paragon heir walking without bodyguards? Bold.
Does daddy know you're slumming it on {planet}?
Every badge on this street answers to your family. Must be nice.
They say Paragon heirs learn to salute before they learn to walk.
Your family's slogan is on every baton on {planet}.
Somebody said a Paragon heir walked in. I assumed it was a raid.
pc_class_heir_halcyon: Halcyon owns the debt on my bed. So, technically, you're standing on my mattress.
A Halcyon heir. My whole family's in your ledger.
Your family repossessed my uncle's kidney. He wants it back.
Interest compounds, they say. So does resentment.
Do you get a discount on your own debt? Asking for {planet}.
My whole street owes your surname money.
Halcyon heir on {planet}? Collecting in person now?
pc_class_heir_gristle: Gristle heir, huh? I've eaten your family's paste every day for #small_num# years.
Is it true Gristle heirs never eat the paste?
Your family's factory smells reach the whole block.
Tell your family the Mystery Paste has a tooth in it. Again.
Heir to the paste empire. Do you dream in beige?
My lunch has your family name on it. Literally. It's stamped in.
Does the paste taste better when you own it?
pc_class_heir_oxy: An OxyGenix heir! I'm breathing your merchandise right now.
Your family sells the air. I just rent it.
Do OxyGenix heirs breathe for free? Seems unfair.
Every breath I take, your family takes a cut.
My lungs are on your family's payment plan.
Breathe in. That one's on your family. Breathe out. That one's on me.
Your family's ad wakes me up every morning. Through the wall.
pc_class_heir_lumen: Lumen heir. Your family decides what I believe every morning.
Are we on camera right now? With you we're always on camera.
Your family cancelled my favourite show for being 'too true'.
Lumen said it was sunny. Your family lies about the weather.
Can you get me on #media_product#? I can cry on cue.
Are you here to make a documentary about us poor folk?
Say hi to your family's cameras. They're always here anyway.
pc_class_old_money: Old money. You can smell it - it smells like real wood.
Your family was rich before the air was sold. Must be peaceful.
Nice coat. Real fabric? I could live a month on one sleeve.
People like you don't come down here unless they're buying the street.
Inherited, right? Nobody earns that posture.
Your great-grandparents bought this street, didn't they? Twice.
You've never queued for anything, have you?
pc_class_executive: Executive type, huh? Here to 'experience the street'?
Let me guess - you restructured somebody today.
Do executives breathe the same air? Asking for my lungs.
Your shoes cost more than my block.
You've got 'quarterly results' written all over you.
Is this a site visit? Should I look productive?
pc_class_middle_manager: Middle manager. I can see the spreadsheets in your eyes.
You look like you approve expense reports. Approve mine?
Squeezed from above, squeezing below, right?
Another middle-tier soul. Hanging on, like the rest of us.
Let me guess: you have a performance review on Monday.
You look like you've survived #small_num# restructures.
pc_class_gig_worker: Gig worker? Me too. #job.cap# on weekdays, #job# on weekends.
How many apps are you on? I'm on nine.
You look like you're mid-delivery. You're always mid-delivery.
Don't tip, they take it anyway.
Your wristpad keeps buzzing with offers, doesn't it?
Rate me five stars and I'll rate you five stars.
pc_class_working_poor: Working poor, like the rest of us. Welcome to the club. Membership is mandatory.
Three jobs? Four? You look like four.
We're the ones who keep {planet} running. Nobody says thanks.
Payday's Friday. The money's gone by Thursday.
We should unionise. Quietly. With snacks.
pc_class_indebted: You've got the debt look. Eyes that count interest in their sleep.
How deep are you in? Me, I can't see the surface.
Halcyon's been asking about you. They ask about everyone. But they ask about you more.
Debt's a ghost that follows you, huh?
I know that face. That's a #big_num#-credit face.
Got a collector following you? Third drone on the left.
pc_class_street_beggar: You've been sleeping rough. I can tell. No judgement - so have I.
The shelter on the corner has heat on Wednesdays.
Here. Half a ration. It's the good half.
The ad-bridge is warmest after midnight. Trust me.
Rough out there. Rougher in here. Stay close to the vents.
Corner by the noodle stall is warm. Don't tell the others.
If you need a blanket, the pawn shop throws out the stained ones at #time#.
pc_class_collateral: That's a barcode on your neck. Who owns you?
Collateral, huh? My sister was collateral. Then she was a factory.
Somebody's paying interest on YOU. Must feel strange.
Owned and still walking around. Respect.
Does your owner know you're on {planet}?
Do they let you keep the barcode when you pay it off?
Owned? Me too, kind of. My landlord thinks so.
pc_class_off_grid: You don't show up on the scanners. How?
No wristpad, no barcode, no record. You're a ghost.
The drones look right through you. Teach me.
Off-grid on {planet}? That's practically a superpower.
I can't even find you on Lumen. Nobody's not on Lumen.
How do you buy anything without a face scan?
The drones went quiet when you walked past. Creepy. Good creepy.
pc_age_teen: Shouldn't you be in a learning-subscription?
Aren't you a bit young for {planet}?
Kids these days. Already in debt. Respect.
How old are you? {years}? I was paying air tax at {years} too.
Go home, kid. Oh. This is home. Sorry.
{years}? I had three jobs at {years}. Kidding. Four.
Does your mum know you're on {planet}?
pc_age_young: You've still got that hope in your eyes. Give it a month.
You look like you still think things get better.
Enjoy your knees while they're original.
You'll get used to the smog. Or it'll get used to you.
Young people still believe the ads. Don't.
pc_age_prime: You look like you've seen a few things.
Prime of life, they say. Prime for billing.
You've got that 'survived a recession' look.
Not young, not old. Just tired, right?
You've got good years left. Billable years.
Old enough to know better, young enough to do it anyway.
pc_age_middle: Middle-aged and still out here. Respect.
Your back hurts too, doesn't it? It's the gravity tax.
You've paid for a lot of air in your time.
Mid-life crisis? Buy a sky-bike. Everyone does.
pc_age_elder: Respect, grandparent. You survived this long.
My nan says air used to be free. You'd know - was it?
You've outlived three ad campaigns. Teach me.
Elders get a discount on Tuesdays. It's 1%.
Still walking at {years}? Teach me your secret. Is it spite?
Respect your elders, they told me. Nobody told the landlord.
pc_age_ancient: How old ARE you? You remember the world before the Consortium?
You've got the eyes of someone who saw real trees.
{years} years old? On {planet}? That's a miracle or a clerical error.
Tell me about the old world. Was there sky? Real sky?
They should put you in a museum. Respectfully.
{years} years... you remember free air, don't you?
You're older than the Consortium. Does it scare them? It should.
pc_bg_cryo_debtor: You've got frost burns. Cryo-sleeper, right? What year did they freeze you?
Woke up in a debt freezer, huh? Welcome to the future. It's worse.
Cryo-debtor. Your interest kept growing while you slept.
pc_bg_ex_auditor: Ex-auditor? You've got that 'I've seen the real numbers' look.
Auditors know where the bodies are budgeted.
You used to count #faction#'s money? Is there really that much?
pc_bg_asteroid_miner: Rock dust in your hair. Asteroid miner?
Miners have the best grip on {planet}. And the worst lungs.
Did you dig up anything good out there? Besides a cough?
pc_bg_jingle_composer: Wait - did you write the #brand# jingle? It's been in my head for a decade.
You're the jingle composer! I hate you. I hum you every day.
Disgraced jingle writer, right? What did you do, rhyme 'debt' with 'regret'?
pc_bg_street_medic: You've got that medic look. Tired and sticky.
Street medic? My neighbour owes you her life. And #small_num# credits.
If I faint, you're catching me. Professional duty.
pc_bg_clone_reject: Clone reject? Which number are you? I've met a #num#.
You look like somebody. Somebody expensive.
Rejected clone, huh? Their loss. You've got a good face. Somebody's face.
pc_bg_corp_lawyer: Lawyer. I can tell. You're reading the small print on my face.
Corporate lawyer on {planet}? Who are you suing?
Is talking to you billable? Am I being billed right now?
pc_bg_ad_copywriter: Ad copywriter? You wrote '#slogan#', didn't you?
You people wrote the jingle that lives in my skull rent-free.
Copywriter. Say something persuasive. ...Wow. I almost bought it.
pc_bg_repo_agent: You've got repo eyes. Pricing everything you look at.
Ex-repo? You took my neighbour's door once. Just the door.
Please don't repossess my shoes. They're all I have.
pc_bg_paste_worker: You smell like the vats. Paste worker?
Vat crew! What's really in the Mystery Paste?
Paste under your fingernails. That never washes out, does it?
pc_bg_smuggler: Smuggler. You've got that 'pockets inside pockets' coat.
Anything good in the cargo hold? Asking for nobody.
pc_bg_holo_preacher: Holo-preacher! Say the thing! Say 'Free Breath'!
You preach on the feeds, right? My nan watches you.
Preach to me. I could use a sermon that isn't an ad.
pc_bg_bouncer: You've thrown people out of better clubs than this street.
I feel safer just standing next to you.
pc_bg_netrunner: Netrunner. Your eyes keep scrolling things I can't see.
Can you delete my debt? Asking very quietly.
Jacked in, aren't you? Right now. While we talk.
pc_bg_union_organiser: Union? Here? Say it louder - they hate that.
You're the organiser! The vat crew talks about you.
Workers of {planet}, unite... and then what? Tell me the 'then what'.
pc_bg_ex_paragon: You stand like a cop. Ex-Paragon?
Old Paragon habits. You checked the exits when you walked up.
Ex-cop, huh? Did you quit or did they quit you?
pc_bg_influencer: Influencer, right? Is this a stream? Am I content?
Do I look okay? Are we live?
pc_bg_air_chemist: Air chemist. Can you tell what's in what we're breathing?
Is it true the 'Mountain Fresh' blend is just vent air with perfume?
Chemist, huh? Make us something that doesn't cost per breath.
pc_bg_gambler: Want to bet on how long this conversation lasts?
I'll bet you #small_num# credits you lose that bet.
pc_bg_street_chef: You smell like real garlic. Chef?
Street chef! What's the secret to making paste taste like food?
Cook something for me sometime. Something with colour.
pc_bg_escaped_convict: That's a penal-colony tattoo. Don't worry, I won't tell.
Escaped, huh? From where? The ice moons? Respect.
Hide your wrists. Paragon checks wrists.
pc_bg_android: You're synthetic, aren't you? Your blinks are too regular.
Do synths dream? Do they dream of billboards too?
You're more human than my landlord. That's a compliment.
pc_bg_courier: Courier legs. You've run every alley on {planet}.
Got anything for me? A package? A message? A life?
Couriers know every shortcut. Where's the one out of here?
pc_pers_charming: You smile like you're selling something. I'd probably buy it.
Stop being charming, I'm trying to be miserable.
How do you do that? Make people like you? Teach me.
pc_pers_ruthless: I bet you never say sorry.
Something about you says 'don't owe them money'.
pc_pers_honest: You've got an honest face. Rare. Probably illegal.
You'd make a terrible salesperson. I mean that kindly.
pc_pers_coward: You flinch at the drones too. It's okay. We all do.
Nervous type? Smart. Nervous people live longer here.
You keep looking for the exits. Good instinct.
pc_pers_hothead: You look like you want to punch a billboard. Do it.
Your jaw's clenched. Mine too. It's {planet}.
pc_pers_cynic: You've got that 'seen it all, hated it all' look.
Let me guess: you don't believe a word Lumen says either.
You're not smiling at the ads. Good. Never smile at the ads.
pc_pers_idealist: You still believe things can change, don't you? It's all over your face.
Hope looks good on you. Dangerous, but good.
You're one of those dreamers. {planet} eats dreamers. Be careful.
pc_pers_joker: You've got a laugh in you. I can tell. Let it out, it's free. For now.
Tell me a joke. Please. I need it.
You look like you'd make the drones laugh.
pc_goal_pay_debt: You count every credit twice. Debt?
Paying something off, aren't you? I know the walk.
pc_goal_burn_consortium: You look at the billboards like you want them on fire. Same.
pc_goal_find_sibling: You're looking for someone. Everyone who looks like that is looking for someone.
Lost somebody? You keep checking faces.
pc_goal_get_famous: You want to be on the feeds. I can tell. You keep checking for cameras.
Future celebrity? Remember me when you're famous.
pc_goal_buy_a_planet: You've got big plans. Planet-sized plans.
Someone said you want to buy a whole planet. Can I rent a room?
pc_goal_revenge: There's someone you want to hurt. It's all over you.
You look like a grudge with legs.
pc_goal_find_cure: You're looking for a cure, aren't you? I hope you find it.
Clinics, labs, black markets - you've been to all of them, right?
pc_goal_protect_family: You've got family somewhere. You keep your hand near your wristpad, waiting for their call.
Somebody depends on you. I can tell.
pc_goal_become_ceo: You walk like you're going to run a company one day.
Future CEO? Then remember this street when you're up there.
pc_goal_escape_sprawl: You're trying to get out, aren't you? Off-world.
You look at the sky like it's an exit.
pc_goal_find_love: You lost someone you love. It's in your eyes.
Looking for someone special? Hope they're looking for you too.
pc_goal_redemption: You're trying to make something right. I can tell.
Whatever you did, you're carrying it.
pc_secret_wanted_alias: That's not your real name, is it? Your face says another one.
I've seen your face on a poster. Different name though.
pc_secret_synth_air_allergy: You sneeze every time the vents breathe. Allergic to the good stuff?
Your eyes go red near the canisters. Interesting.
pc_secret_compulsive_liar: Everything you say has a little echo of 'not quite'.
I believe you. That's the scary part.
pc_secret_sleeper_agent: Your shadow moves a second late. Just saying.
Sometimes you stop mid-step like you're listening to orders.
pc_secret_kleptomaniac: Your hands keep drifting toward my pockets. I see them.
Your fingers twitch near anything shiny.
pc_secret_secret_heir: You've got blue blood. Hidden, but blue. I can smell it.
Somebody important is your parent. Somebody VERY important.
pc_secret_terminal_illness: You're running out of time. I can feel it. Spend it well.
You look at everything like it's the last time.
pc_secret_ai_in_head: You're talking to somebody when nobody's there. Who is it?
There's two of you behind your eyes.
pc_secret_killed_someone: You've got blood on you. Old blood. I won't ask.
The dead follow you. Three steps behind.
pc_secret_double_agent: You work for two people. Maybe three.
pc_secret_stolen_identity: That face isn't yours. It fits, but it isn't yours.
Your name doesn't sit right on you.
pc_secret_mob_debt: The Syndicate's ledger has your name in red ink.
Someone very unfriendly wants their money from you.
pc_hurt: You look terrible. Clinic's two streets down. Bring credits.
Sit down before you fall down.
You need a medkit, friend. Or a priest.
That's a lot of red for one person.
Lean on me. Not too hard, I'm rented.
There's a bandage in the vending machine. #small_num# credits.
pc_wanted: There's a bounty on you. {bounty} credits. That's more than my building.
Paragon's been asking about you all week.
If they ask, I was never here. If they pay, I was totally here.
Your face is on the posters. You look shorter in person.
{bounty} credits on your head. Tempting. Kidding. Mostly.
Paragon put your face on the ad screens. Between the paste and the loans.
I'd turn you in, but I hate Paragon more.
pc_famous: Can I get a selfie? I'll pay. Three credits?
My cousin's a big fan. Also a big Paragon informant.
Is it true what Lumen says about you?
My kid has your poster. A bootleg one. Sorry.
You were on #media_product#! Or someone who looks like you.
pc_flush: You're carrying {credits} credits? Put that away before someone sees.
You've got money. I can hear it jingle.
Rich today, huh? Buy something for the street.
With that many credits you could buy this whole corner.
Careful flashing that. Pickpockets on {planet} have pickpockets.
That's a lot of credits for one coat pocket.
pc_broke: Broke? Me too. Let's be broke together.
Empty pockets. I know that sound. That's no sound.
No credits? The noodle stand gives leftovers after midnight.
Don't worry, everyone's broke. The rich just call it 'liquidity'.
Want some advice? It's free. It's the only free thing here.
Broke is just rich without the credits.
pc_debt: Your air debt's at {debt}? Halcyon will come knocking.
{debt} in air debt. They'll repossess your breath.
I can hear your debt growing from here.
Air debt like that, you should hold your breath. Literally.
pc_crew: You travel with {crew}, right? Good people. Weird, but good.
Heard {crew} is on your ship. Tell them hi.
A crew, huh? On the Odd Duck? That ship's a legend. A bad legend.
Your crew looks out for you. Hold on to that.
pc_upgraded: Nice ink. Or is that chrome? Both?
You've had work done. Good work. Expensive work.
pc_killer: People die around you. I've noticed.
They say you've got a body count. They say a lot of things.
Stay back. I heard what you did.
Murderer. That's what they call you on {planet}.
pc_saint: You're the one who helps people. Everybody's talking.
They call you the Sprawl Saint. Don't let it go to your head.
You give credits away. Are you okay? Medically?
Kindness is rare here. People notice.
pc_leader: {followers} people follow you now. That's a movement.
Your people are everywhere. I see the stickers.
Are you starting something? Count me in. Quietly.
pc_planet: {controller} runs {planet}. Runs it into the ground.
This {crisis} is killing us. Slowly. With fees.
Over on {other_planet} they've got {other_crisis}. At least ours is familiar.
{local_name} is the only one fighting for {planet}.
{controller} put a tax on queuing. I'm queuing to complain.
{planet} used to be nice. Before {controller}. Before me.
They say {crisis} will be over by spring. They said that last spring.
pc_saga: They say {antagonist} wants to {scheme}. Lumen calls it 'a bold vision'.
Heard {ally} is looking for someone like you.
Everyone's talking about {macguffin}. Nobody knows what it is.
{antagonist}. The {antagonist_title}. Don't say the name too loud.
{lieutenant} came through here last week. Smiling. Never a good sign.
If you're headed to {objective_planet}, bring a coat. And a lawyer.
{ally} said someone like you would come through. I thought they were drunk.
People whisper about {macguffin} like it's a ghost story.
npc_life: My #kin# just started as #job.a#. So proud. So poor.
I've got #pet_desc# #pet_kind# called #pet_name#. Best thing in my life.
I'm saving up for #aspiration#. #small_num# more years.
My #kin# wants to be #dream.a# when they grow up.
I used to #hobby#. Before the fees.
Today's my day off. I'm spending it standing here. It's free.
I'm {job}. It's a job. That's the best thing I can say about it.
You know what I need? {need}. Same as everyone.
secret_habit: skip the ads with my eyes closed
breathe through my nose to save credits
